These and the mixed cycles generate the actual supported alternating group on X union Y, including the |X|=|Y|=2 case. An odd E element is supported within that union, so its addition gives the actual supported symmetric group.

For each prefix, the disjoint label sets in the ORIGINAL full C-marking give P_j intersect <P_(j-1),E> = P_(j-1). This is actual original IP, not an asserted quotient or enlarged IP. The commutator inclusion thus proves the even kernel inclusion, and the full one when the external group has an odd element.

For K<=Q, inclusion of the full even part Q intersect Alt forces either K=Q or K equal to that even part with index exactly2. If K contains an odd element every odd element of Q differs from it by an even element in K. Thus the stated defect is exact, not merely an upper bound.
